headline: Franky Widjaja Resigns as Commissioner of Sinar Mas Agro (SMAR)
summary: Sinar Mas Agro Resources reshuffled its board of commissioners. David Fernando Audy replaces Franky Oesman Widjaja as president commissioner.
why: Sinar Mas Agro is a listed Indonesian palm oil plantation and processing company, and governance changes can affect its strategic direction.
